When alpha particle scattering experiments were carried out with high-energy alpha particles, deviations from Geiger-Marsden-Rutherford scattering were observed.

What was deduced as a result of this observation?

  1. The size of the alpha particle
  2. The size of the nucleus
  3. The nature of the electrostatic field inside the nucleus
  4. The nature of the weak nuclear force within the nucleus
